title: CapitalCraft
description: Capitalism in Minecraft, Money, Charts, ATMs, Biomes, CEOs
body:
# CapitalCraft

## Description
A Fabric mod for Minecraft that has a finance/trading system with ATM banking a trading terminal and many more features
![recepies and blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/579c40e9b11010f84ae593fe2d9bb639e7ff3cbe.png)
## Compatibility
- Minecraft: 1.21.8
- Fabric Loader: 0.19.1
- Yarn Mappings: 1.21.8+build.1
- Fabric API: 0.136.1+1.21.8
- Mod Version: 1.0-SNAPSHOT ; newest: 1.1

## Features
### Banking
- ATM block with screen
- ATM withdraw (makes balance to Money (voucher))
- Money item for trading with villagers for op loot
- Wallet HUD overlay showing current balance in EUR and USD
- `/money <amount>` command to set player cash (for testing)

### Trading Terminal
- Terminal block with screen
- Asset buy/sell directly in the terminal
- Refresh pricing per asset from the terminal (R Button)
- Candle chart panel in terminal UI (C button)

![gui blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69badc74b4de7457379beb3b4faf6bbaa148ae4a.png)

### NPC & Villagers
- CEO NPC spawns in biome
 ![ceos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/092da91a4bce297d290a458d504810650f7250f3_0.webp)
- ATM Dealer villager when near ATM
![villagertrades](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/812f2b3f467edcd659a60a9de51bfb47eec3d639.png)
### World Generation & Theming
- Silicon Valley biome with Skyscrapers
![skyscraper generation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7eb3a5fdd04cb758ba3b4b9b2f2d55b21e61867e.png)
### Crafting & Items
- recipes for ATM and Terminal
